comment: Each entry is built by .github/workflows/build-modules.yml via scripts/build-local.sh and published to the 'modules' GitHub Release as modules.json, in the schema runtime/module-manager.py expects. Add a new entry here (and open a PR) for each new Unraid kernel release you want a prebuilt module for; status 'supported' means it has been validated on real hardware, 'build-only' means CI built and metadata-checked it but nobody has booted it on a real RTX 3090/GA102 card yet.
